# Mohamed Yaakoubi

> AI Language Technology Specialist, Machine Translation Post-Editor, and AI Annotator & Evaluator based in Sfax, Tunisia, and builder of SheetDiff™, a Google Sheets™ comparison add-on and Structural Diff API.

Mohamed Yaakoubi works at the intersection of language, AI, and localization. His evaluation and localization work spans Meta AI (via RWS), Uber (via Volga Partners), DeepL, Unbabel, Lionbridge, DATAmundi, and Wirestock, with a focus on Arabic-English AI evaluation, LLM prompt testing, and multimodal annotation. He also builds web applications with React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Firebase.

The site is available in English (/en), French (/fr), and Arabic (/ar); the links below point to the English versions.

## Projects
- [SheetDiff™](https://www.mohamedyaakoubi.com/en/sheetdiff): Google Sheets™ add-on that compares two spreadsheet versions and reports modified, moved, split, merged, added, and deleted rows, with SKU-based matching, WER/CER/SER quality metrics, and a duplicate finder.
- [Potential](https://www.mohamedyaakoubi.com/en/projects/potential): AI search engine for the Abu Dhabi Open Data Platform (Abu Dhabi Spark AI Hackathon) that matches plain-language questions to open datasets.
- [DocuMed](https://www.mohamedyaakoubi.com/en/projects/documed): Full-stack healthcare management platform connecting doctors and patients, with dual dashboards, real-time appointment scheduling, and secure medical records.
- [InternationalSkills](https://www.mohamedyaakoubi.com/en/projects/internationalskills): Recruiting management system for InternationalSkills.fi with candidate registration, AI-powered scoring, Google Meet interview scheduling, and an HR dashboard.

## SheetDiff™ documentation
- [Structural Diff API](https://www.mohamedyaakoubi.com/en/sheetdiff/api-docs): REST API overview for structural spreadsheet diffing.
- [Parameters](https://www.mohamedyaakoubi.com/en/sheetdiff/api-docs/parameters): Request configuration parameters.
- [Diff statuses](https://www.mohamedyaakoubi.com/en/sheetdiff/api-docs/diff-statuses): Meaning of each row-level diff status.
- [Engine precision](https://www.mohamedyaakoubi.com/en/sheetdiff/api-docs/engine-precision): Matching accuracy and benchmarks.
- [Playground](https://www.mohamedyaakoubi.com/en/sheetdiff/api-docs/playground): Interactive comparison demo.
- [Pricing](https://www.mohamedyaakoubi.com/en/sheetdiff/pricing): Free trial, free tier, and Pro plans.
